name: Omegane Teacher -Valentine Plan-
original_name: おめがねティーチャー Valentine Plan
source:
Main character lives alone with his sister while parents transfer overseas. As graduation approaches, he gets a call from female teacher Saya inviting him to receive chocolate on a Valentine Day. That's as good as direct confession! Protagonist's sister is willing to protect her brother from the poison of other women, so she invents a plan to sabotage the meeting.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/05/vn-of-month-february-2003-routes.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
父母被外派海外后，主人公与妹妹两人独自生活。
临近毕业时，他接到女教师沙耶的电话，邀请他在情人节收下巧克力。
这几乎等同于直接告白！
主人公的妹妹愿意保护哥哥不受其他女人的“毒害”，于是策划破坏这次见面。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/05/vn-of-month-february-2003-routes.html]vndbreview[/url]]
